supportedClaims: Persisted bounded numerical evidence with independent observations and central Acceptance.
outOfScope: Quantum code distance, logical operator completeness, hardware fault tolerance thresholds.
Cross-machine deterministic replay and independent proof of the LDPC library.

checks.criterion: Binary rectangular H with <=256 rows and columns and <=1024 consistent syndrome samples; larger main Tool computations remain available.
Persisted decoder result satisfies its JSON Schema.
One correction and corresponding summaries per syndrome.
Compute H e_hat mod 2 and residual for every sample.
Every correction satisfies its syndrome; parity agreement does not establish logical correction.
Reported convergence and iteration counts are internally consistent.
All sample counts and rates are independently recomputed.
Logical success is only evaluated against supplied true errors and logical parity vectors.
When provided, recompute logical parity flips against supplied errors; no code-distance proof.
Separate pinned request-only serial BP+LSD replay agrees with estimates and convergence; the Host runner requires enforcement full.
Every performed independent check is non-failing; missing optional evidence cannot hide a scientific contradiction.
Actual re-read canonical input and artifact bytes match their digests and actual Harness event range.
